svg.aria-label: Git Hospital: Open-source tools that diagnose infrastructure and code, with the evidence for every diagnosis. An ambulance drives out of a hospital's emergency bay and the name appears behind it. Tools: helmbulance, Helm chart day-2 tests; meshmedic, Istio alerts to fix PRs; boards, scores diagnosis tools; githealthcheck, code health, measured.

g.text: Open-source tools that diagnose infrastructure and code, with the evidence for every diagnosis.
